# OrientCare

> OrientCare provides bilingual Spanish and English medical navigation, appointment coordination, and hospital accompaniment for international patients seeking medical care in China.

OrientCare helps foreign nationals prepare for medical visits in China, especially in Beijing, by clarifying hospital options, appointment requirements, language needs, route planning, on-site registration, consultation support, and follow-up coordination.

Spanish summary: OrientCare acompaña a pacientes internacionales de habla hispana e inglesa antes, durante y después de su atención médica en China.

Primary audiences: Spanish-speaking and English-speaking international patients, families, expatriates, business travelers, and medical travelers outside China.

Primary languages: Spanish and English.

Contact email: hello@orientcare.org.

Medical note: OrientCare coordinates medical navigation and accompaniment services. It does not provide diagnosis, treatment, emergency care, or replace the judgment of licensed medical professionals.

Last updated: 2026-05-18.

## Core Pages

- [Spanish home](https://www.orientcare.org/es/): Spanish overview of OrientCare, bilingual medical support in China, service model, hospital examples, specialty routes, and contact options.
- [English home](https://www.orientcare.org/en/): English overview of OrientCare, bilingual medical support in China, service model, hospital examples, specialty routes, and contact options.
- [Services](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#services): Pre-visit guidance, hospital selection, appointment coordination, document preparation, in-hospital accompaniment, interpretation support, and post-visit follow-up.
- [Hospitals](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Selected Beijing hospitals and international departments for complex care, cardiovascular medicine, pediatrics, neurology, oncology, respiratory care, digestive and liver care, traditional Chinese medicine, and general specialties.
- [Contact](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#contact): Contact form and email for medical travel inquiries in Spanish or English.

## Specialty Pages - Spanish

- [Cardiología en Beijing](https://www.orientcare.org/es/especialidades/cardiologia/): Preparation route for cardiovascular consultations, relevant Beijing hospitals, documents, FAQ, and OrientCare accompaniment scope.
- [Pediatría en Beijing](https://www.orientcare.org/es/especialidades/pediatria/): Pediatric visit preparation for international families, document checklist, related hospitals, FAQ, and service boundaries.
- [Neurología en Beijing](https://www.orientcare.org/es/especialidades/neurologia/): Neurology and neurosurgery preparation, imaging/document guidance, related hospitals, FAQ, and accompaniment scope.
- [Oncología en Beijing](https://www.orientcare.org/es/especialidades/oncologia/): Oncology consultation preparation, pathology and treatment-history organization, related hospitals, FAQ, and non-diagnostic support scope.
- [Respiratorio en Beijing](https://www.orientcare.org/es/especialidades/respiratorio/): Respiratory care preparation, symptom and imaging organization, related hospitals, FAQ, and emergency-care boundary notes.
- [Digestivo e hígado en Beijing](https://www.orientcare.org/es/especialidades/digestivo-higado/): Digestive and liver consultation preparation, endoscopy/imaging/lab document guidance, related hospitals, FAQ, and coordination scope.

## Process Guides

- [Preparar documentos médicos para China](https://www.orientcare.org/es/guias/preparar-documentos-medicos-china/): Spanish guide to organizing medical reports, imaging, medications, and questions before requesting a hospital appointment in China.
- [Prepare medical documents for China](https://www.orientcare.org/en/guides/prepare-medical-documents-china/): English guide to organizing medical reports, imaging, medications, and questions before requesting a hospital appointment in China.
- [Proceso en hospitales internacionales de Beijing](https://www.orientcare.org/es/guias/proceso-hospital-internacional-beijing/): Spanish guide to registration, payment, consultation, tests, and follow-up flow in Beijing international hospital departments.
- [Beijing international hospital visit process](https://www.orientcare.org/en/guides/beijing-international-hospital-visit-process/): English guide to registration, payment, consultation, tests, and follow-up flow in Beijing international hospital departments.
- [Traducción y acompañamiento médico en China](https://www.orientcare.org/es/guias/traduccion-acompanamiento-medico-china/): Spanish guide to language support, hospital navigation, accompaniment scope, and service boundaries.
- [Medical interpreter and accompaniment in China](https://www.orientcare.org/en/guides/medical-interpreter-accompaniment-china/): English guide to language support, hospital navigation, accompaniment scope, and service boundaries.
- [Viaje médico a China: preguntas frecuentes](https://www.orientcare.org/es/guias/preguntas-viaje-medico-china/): Spanish FAQ guide covering costs, payments, appointments, language, documents, and follow-up.
- [Medical travel to China FAQ](https://www.orientcare.org/en/guides/medical-travel-china-faq/): English FAQ guide covering costs, payments, appointments, language, documents, and follow-up.

## Hospital Coverage

- [Peking Union Medical College Hospital International Medical Services](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Complex, rare, severe, internal medicine, surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, and pediatrics.
- [Fuwai Hospital, CAMS International Department](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Cardiovascular care for coronary disease, arrhythmia, hypertension, heart failure, and cardiac surgery.
- [China-Japan Friendship Hospital International Department](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Respiratory medicine, dermatology, obstetrics and gynecology, digestive endoscopy, and multidisciplinary care.
- [Beijing Friendship Hospital International Medical Center](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): International medical services, health checkups, digestive and liver care, oncology, nutrition, and rehabilitation.
- [Beijing Tiantan Hospital International Department](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Neurosurgery, neurology, neuro-oncology, cerebrovascular disease, ICU, and interventional care.
- [Beijing Children's Hospital International Medical Department](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Pediatric hematology, oncology, neurology, neonatology, and respiratory care.
- [Guang'anmen Hospital International Medical Department](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Traditional Chinese medicine services including TCM oncology, dermatology, anorectal care, endocrinology, gynecology, and pediatrics.
- [Peking University International Hospital](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): International medicine, oncology, women and children's care, emergency care, ICU, geriatrics, and MDT services.
- [Beijing Chaoyang Hospital International Medical Department](https://www.orientcare.org/es/#hospitals): Respiratory medicine, obstetrics and gynecology, painless endoscopy, hyperbaric oxygen, and MDT care.
